 In a title fight, Mexican boxer Canelo Alvarez defends his WBC super middleweight title belts against Cameroonian French-Canadian fighter Christian M’billi in a scheduled for 12 rounds of boxing on DAZN .
 $79.99 watch PPV On DAZN 
 On Saturday, Oct. 31, Alvarez (63-3-2) vs. M’billi (29-0-1) takes place at ANB Arena (formerly The Venue) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with a start time of 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT. Ringwalk for the main event is expected around 4:30 p.m. ET/1:30 p.m. PT.

 With Canelo Alvarez competing against Christian M’billi in Riyadh, it’s likely the boxing event may feature a few of celebrities in attendance. Including fans who attended fights in Saudi Arabia past fights, like Anthony Joshua, Tyson Fury, Manny Pacquiao, Jason Statham, Cristiano Ronaldo, Sofía Vergara and others.
 For the title bout this weekend, Alvarez is the heavy favorite to retain the championship belt. However, M’billi is a well-rounded boxer too, so it’s likely the fight will go the distance. And with the title on the line, M’billi is looking for extra motivation for an upset.

 watch on DAZN 
 Alvarez vs. M’billi is available as a pay-per-view live boxing event goes for $79.99 on DAZN for subscribers. Not a DAZN subscriber? You can purchase access starting at $24.99/month (was $34.99/month) with 8-day free trial.
 Fight Card 
 Super Middleweight: Canelo Alvarez (champion) vs. Christian M’billi — Main Event, WBC Title Fight
 Super Middleweight: Jaime Munguia (champion) vs. Nikita Zon — WBA Title Fight
 Featherweight: Rafael Espinoza (champion) vs. Lorenzo Parra — WBO Title
 Junior Welterweight: Lindolfo Delgado vs. Arthur Biyarslanov — IBF Title Fight (vacant)
 Super Featherweight: Raymond Rojas Garcia vs. Reito Tsutsumi
 Junior Featherweight: David Picasso vs. Carl Jammes Martin
 Junior Lightweight: Reito Tsutsumi vs. Raymundo Rojas Garcia
 Taking place on Saturday, Oct. 31, Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian M’billi is available to livestream for $79.99 on DAZN starting at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT.
